breaking.change: Every game shader (material, post and UI shaders) now has `srgb_encode`, `srgb_decode`, `luma` and `const LUMA` (Rec.709 weights) in scope, from the engine's one copy; a shader that declares one of these names no longer compiles.
breaking.fix: Delete your own copy and call the library's (it is the standard sRGB curve and Rec.709 luminance), or rename yours.

added.summary: A game shader may call the sRGB curve both ways and the luminance of linear light without writing them.
